project_name.justification: The authoritative project name is Notre-Dame. The text refers to it as: "SLAM the option to acquire a 51% interest in the Notre Dame Niobium Critical Mineral Project (the “Notre Dame Project”)."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as: "SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSX-V: SXL) (“SLAM” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce it has signed an arm’s length binding term sheet..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in the text: "Mike Taylor P.Geo, President and CEO of SLAM Exploration Ltd., is a qualified person as defined by National Instrument 43-101, and has approved the contents of this news release."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: SLAM can acquire an initial 51% interest, with an option to acquire the remaining 49% for a total of 100%. The text states: "to earn a 51% interest in and to the Notre Dame Project... Alternatively, St-Georges has the option to grant SLAM the remaining 49% ownership interest..." and confirms the 100% possibility: "In the event that SLAM purchases a 100% interest in and to the Notre Dame Project..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly identified as a Niobium project in the headline and body: "SLAM Exploration Acquires New Niobium Critical Mineral Project" and "the Notre Dame Niobium Critical Mineral Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is about the correct project, but no URL for the article is present in the source document.

currency.justification: The text uses the '$' symbol for payments. The acquiring company, SLAM Exploration Ltd., is listed on the TSX-V, a Canadian exchange, implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of two tranches: "Payment of $25,000 cash... on or before March 31st, 2024." and "Payment of $25,000 cash... on or before the 1st anniversary date of a definitive option agreement." This totals $50,000.

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction involves the issuance of shares, but no dollar value is assigned to these shares in the deal terms. Per the extraction hierarchy, this field is null when `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are used.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The deal terms are broken down into separate cash and share components, not a single combined value. Per the extraction hierarchy, this field is null.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total shares issued is the sum of all tranches for 100% ownership: 500,000 shares upon approval, 500,000 shares by March 2024, 1,000,000 shares by the first anniversary (for the initial 51%), and an additional 1,000,000 shares for the remaining 49%. The text states: "Issuance of 500,000 common shares... Payment of $25,000 cash and issuance of 500,000 common shares... Payment of $25,000 cash and issuance of 1,000,000 common shares... Alternatively, St-Georges has the option to grant SLAM the remaining 49% ownership interest... by issuing 1,000,000 common shares of SLAM to St-Georges."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any payments for options.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.045'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement includes a commitment for exploration expenditures: "Engage $300,000 in qualified exploration work before the 2nd anniversary of a definitive option agreement."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller retains a 2% NSR if SLAM acquires 100% interest. The text states: "In the event that SLAM purchases a 100% interest in and to the Notre Dame Project by making the 4th payment referenced above, St-Georges will retain a NSR of 2%."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The project size is explicitly stated: "The project covers 6,404 hectares (64 km²) comprised of 116 mineral claims."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is given in the same sentence: "The project covers 6,404 hectares..."

resource_size.justification: The text provides grades from grab samples ("Grab samples range up to 2,320 ppm niobium (0.33% Nb2O5)") but does not contain a quantified statement of mineral resources with a mass or volume (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first sentence of the article: "SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSX-V: SXL)". This is confirmed in the detailed quote section: "Exchange: TSXV".
